Your reply time is part of your website.

Sunday, 21:12. A homeowner asks your site chat for a rough price. (Illustrative chat, not a real installer.)

"We'll get back to you within 2–3 working days" is an answer too. It tells them to keep looking.

What a site can do instead, even when the office is closed:
→ link to an instant estimate: price range, savings, payback
→ offer real survey times they can book in one tap
→ say when a real person will follow up, and keep to it

You don't need a 24/7 team. You need a website that answers the first question and books the next step.

DM us "AUDIT" for a free, honest website teardown.
